data.description: Element air; Type form infusion; Level 4; Burn 3 Associated Blasts air, blizzard, sandstorm, thunderstorm Saving Throw Reflex half You create a circular rush of wind. All creatures and objects within a 20-foot-radius burst centered on you take half your blast's normal amount of damage. The saving throw DC is Dexterity-based.
